verdicts.title: Reentrancy via _safeMint callback bypasses per-address mint limits and the 1-mint-per-period rule

b.reden: Both describe reentrancy through the mint flow where per-address mint counters are updated after the external _safeMint call, allowing limits to be bypassed and excess supply to be minted.

b.reden: Same AuctionDemo boundary bug at block.timestamp == auctionEndTime allowing both claimAuction and cancelBid, enabling ETH drain/double refund.
